title: GUI SFT record
description: One training example of the GUI SFT distillation dataset. Files are JSONL: one object per line, UTF-8, no trailing commas. 'frame' is relative to the frames root used at collection time (the same root passed to scripts/train_gui_sft.py as --frames-dir); absolute paths are invalid.

episode_id.description: Stable episode identifier, e.g. 'click-dialog_20101'. Shared by all steps of one rollout.

step.description: 0-based index of this action inside the episode.

task.description: MiniWoB task id (or the task id of the source environment).

seed.description: Environment seed of the episode; unique per (task, seed) rollout.

instruction.description: Raw task instruction shown to the model (the MiniWoB goal text for oracle data).

frame.description: Screenshot path relative to the frames root, POSIX separators. Backslashes are normalised to '/'.

frame_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the screenshot bytes; used for integrity checks and content dedup.

history.description: Previous target actions of the same episode, oldest first, as <action>...</action> strings.

error_feedback.description: Last environment/executor error shown to the policy, or null.

target_action.description: Constrained action DSL. click(x,y) and scroll(dx,dy) use normalised coordinates; type("...") carries JSON-escaped text; type(@start:end|lower|upper) is the copy-pointer form; stop(done) ends the episode.

action_kind.description: Kind parsed from target_action; must agree with it.

data_source.description: Where the row came from. V14 oracle rows are never GUI-Owl rows.

split.description: train or validation. Frozen test rows are kept in a separate file and are never assigned to either split.

reward.description: Environment reward of the episode, or null when the teacher did not record one. Must be finite.

success.description: Environment-verified success of the episode. null means unverified; true must come from the environment, never from a heuristic.

target_point.description: Normalised [x, y] for click rows (equal to the click coordinates), null otherwise.

examples.instruction: Click the button to close the dialog.
